statusHistory.note: Operator request (chat, 2026-09-21): fifth and final pin in this Salvador push. O Cravinho is a Pelourinho institution founded by Julival Santos in the late 1980s (bahia.ba gives 1987; a separate outlet gives 1989 — genuine source disagreement, resolved in the body by saying 'late 1980s' rather than picking one to sound precise) as a bar for artisanal infused cachaça (clove, jatobá bark, cinnamon, honey, lime), reviving a recipe tradition rooted in Black and indigenous ancestry. Google Maps verified live via browser: 4.7 stars, 2,661 reviews, open now, Largo Terreiro de Jesus 3. Deliberately did not conflate with 'O Cravinho do Carlinhos,' a separate, lower-rated (4.3/196) competing venue that surfaces in the same searches. A 2026-dated food-safety raid story (A TARDE) was found and read but excluded from the body — the coverage shows it was resolved within a day via a UFBA lab clearance and federal re-certification, so citing the raid without that resolution would misrepresent current status; the piece instead reflects the bar's actual current standing (open, thriving, 2,661 recent reviews). Reviews read directly: consistently positive on the cachaça and the moela de frango, with one practical note (seating and bathroom access both cost extra). Instagram (@cravinhobar, 47.6K followers) supplied a real, non-AI photo of the bar's own hanging sign for the hero. No genuine dated event applicable. Single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive. This closes out the operator's 5-post Salvador push for this session.
